:root {
  --ms-blue: #0078d4;
  --ms-blue-dark: #005a9e;
  --ms-blue-light: #c7e0f4;
  --ms-blue-faint: #eff6fc;
  --ms-teal: #038387;
  --ms-teal-light: #d1f1f2;
  --ms-green: #107c10;
  --ms-green-light: #dff6dd;
  --ms-red: #a4262c;
  --ms-red-light: #fed9cc;
  --ms-orange: #ca5010;
  --ms-orange-light: #fce4d6;
  --ms-purple: #5c2d91;
  --ms-purple-light: #e8ddf7;
  --moss: #107c10;
  --brass: #ca5010;
  --rule-red: #a4262c;
  --neutral-0: #fff;
  --neutral-2: #f8f9fa;
  --neutral-4: #f3f2f1;
  --neutral-6: #edebe9;
  --neutral-10: #e1dfdd;
  --neutral-20: #c8c6c4;
  --neutral-40: #a19f9d;
  --neutral-60: #605e5c;
  --neutral-80: #3b3a39;
  --neutral-100: #201f1e;
  --bg-canvas: #f3f2f1;
  --bg-surface: #fff;
  --bg-overlay: #f8f9fa;
  --border-default: #e1dfdd;
  --border-strong: #c8c6c4;
  --text-primary: #201f1e;
  --text-secondary: #605e5c;
  --text-disabled: #a19f9d;
  --text-on-accent: #fff;
  --shadow-4: 0 1.6px 3.6px #00000021, 0 .3px .9px #0000001c;
  --shadow-8: 0 3.2px 7.2px #00000021, 0 .6px 1.8px #0000001c;
  --shadow-16: 0 6.4px 14.4px #00000021, 0 1.2px 3.6px #0000001c;
  --radius-sm: 2px;
  --radius-md: 4px;
  --radius-lg: 8px;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
  background: var(--bg-canvas);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  margin: 0;
  font-family: Segoe UI, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, sans-serif;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.mono {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  font-family: Cascadia Code, Consolas, Courier New, monospace;
}

h1, h2, h3, h4 {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

h1 {
  font-size: 24px;
}

h2 {
  font-size: 20px;
}

h3 {
  font-size: 16px;
}

h4 {
  font-size: 14px;
}

p {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin: 0 0 10px;
}

#login-screen {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a1628 0%, #003066 50%, #0078d4 100%);
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: 20px;
  display: flex;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

#login-screen:before {
  content: "";
  background-image: linear-gradient(#ffffff0a 1px, #0000 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, #ffffff0a 1px, #0000 1px);
  background-size: 40px 40px;
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
}

.login-box {
  z-index: 1;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 410px;
  position: relative;
}

.login-logo {
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
  display: flex;
}

.login-logo-icon {
  background: var(--ms-blue);
  color: #fff;
  border-radius: 8px;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  display: flex;
}

.login-logo-text {
  color: #fff;
}

.login-logo-text .product-name {
  letter-spacing: -.2px;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: block;
}

.login-logo-text .product-sub {
  color: #ffffffa6;
  font-size: 12px;
  display: block;
}

.login-card {
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-16);
  background: #fffffffa;
  padding: 32px;
}

.login-card h3 {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  font-size: 18px;
}

label {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: block;
}

input, select, textarea {
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--neutral-0);
  width: 100%;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  outline: none;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 14px;
  transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s;
}

input::placeholder {
  color: var(--text-disabled);
}

input:hover, select:hover, textarea:hover {
  border-color: var(--neutral-40);
}

input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus {
  border-color: var(--ms-blue);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ms-blue);
}

textarea {
  resize: vertical;
}

select {
  cursor: pointer;
}

button {
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: none;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: background .15s, box-shadow .15s, border-color .15s, color .15s;
  display: inline-flex;
}

.btn-primary {
  background: var(--ms-blue);
  color: var(--text-on-accent);
  justify-content: center;
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 8px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.btn-primary:hover {
  background: var(--ms-blue-dark);
}

.btn-primary:active {
  transform: translateY(1px);
}

.btn-secondary {
  background: var(--neutral-0);
  color: var(--ms-blue);
  border: 1px solid var(--ms-blue);
}

.btn-secondary:hover {
  background: var(--ms-blue-faint);
}

.btn-ghost {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  background: none;
}

.btn-ghost:hover {
  background: var(--neutral-4);
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}

.btn-danger {
  color: var(--ms-red);
  border: 1px solid var(--ms-red-light);
  background: none;
}

.btn-danger:hover {
  background: var(--ms-red-light);
}

.btn-sm {
  padding: 5px 10px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.btn-link {
  color: var(--ms-blue);
  cursor: pointer;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.btn-link:hover {
  color: var(--ms-blue-dark);
}

.btn-link-red {
  color: var(--ms-red);
  cursor: pointer;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.x-btn {
  color: var(--ms-red);
  cursor: pointer;
  opacity: .75;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1;
}

.x-btn:hover {
  opacity: 1;
  background: var(--ms-red-light);
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.error-text {
  color: var(--ms-red);
  margin: 6px 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  display: block;
}

.success-text {
  color: var(--ms-green);
  font-size: 13px;
  display: block;
}

#app-shell {
  min-height: 100vh;
}

header.app-header {
  background: var(--ms-blue-dark);
  z-index: 100;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  height: 48px;
  padding: 0 24px;
  display: flex;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
}

header.app-header .brand {
  color: var(--text-on-accent);
  letter-spacing: -.1px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: flex;
}

header.app-header .brand-icon {
  background: #fff3;
  border-radius: 4px;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  display: flex;
}

header.app-header .header-right {
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  display: flex;
}

header.app-header .who {
  color: var(--text-on-accent);
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  display: flex;
}

header.app-header .who-name {
  font-weight: 500;
}

header.app-header .btn-logout {
  color: var(--text-on-accent);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: #ffffff1f;
  border: 1px solid #fff3;
  padding: 5px 12px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

header.app-header .btn-logout:hover {
  background: #ffffff38;
}

.role-badge {
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .04em;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: inline-block;
}

.role-badge-hr {
  background: var(--ms-purple-light);
  color: var(--ms-purple);
}

.role-badge-manager {
  background: var(--ms-teal-light);
  color: var(--ms-teal);
}

.role-badge-dept_head {
  background: var(--ms-blue-faint);
  color: var(--ms-blue);
}

.role-badge-employee {
  background: var(--ms-green-light);
  color: var(--ms-green);
}

.subnav-bar {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  gap: 0;
  padding: 0 24px;
  display: flex;
  overflow-x: auto;
}

.subnav-bar button {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  background: none;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 3px solid #0000;
  border-radius: 0;
  padding: 12px 16px 11px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  transition: color .15s, border-color .15s;
}

.subnav-bar button:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: var(--neutral-4);
}

.subnav-bar button.active {
  color: var(--ms-blue);
  border-bottom-color: var(--ms-blue);
  font-weight: 600;
}

main.app-main {
  max-width: 960px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 28px 24px;
}

.page-header {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  display: flex;
}

.page-title {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.page-sub {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-top: 2px;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.card {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  padding: 20px;
}

.card-header {
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  display: flex;
}

.card-title {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.form-card {
  background: var(--bg-overlay);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding: 20px;
}

.form-grid {

  gap: 12px;

}

.form-field {
  flex-direction: column;

}

.form-row {

table {

  width: 100%;
  font-size: 13px;
}

thead {
  background: var(--neutral-4);
}

th {
  text-align: left;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .05em;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  padding: 10px 12px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

td {
  text-align: left;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  padding: 10px 12px;
}

tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: none;
}

tr:hover td {
  background: var(--neutral-2);
}

.emp-card {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.emp-head {
  cursor: pointer;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  user-select: none;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  display: flex;
}

.emp-head:hover {
  background: var(--neutral-2);
}

.emp-avatar {
  background: var(--ms-blue);

  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  display: flex;
}

.emp-info {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.emp-name {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.emp-sub {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-top: 1px;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.emp-head-right {
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  display: flex;
}

.emp-body {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  background: var(--neutral-2);
  padding: 18px;
}

.profile-grid {
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  display: grid;
}

.profile-field span {
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .05em;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 3px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: block;
}

.profile-field strong {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.purpose-block {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  margin-top: 4px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
}

.section-label {
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .06em;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: block;
}

.kra-item {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.kra-title-row {
  background: var(--neutral-4);
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 9px 12px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: flex;
}

.kra-obj {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 12px 6px 24px;
  font-size: 13px;
  display: flex;
}

.kra-add-row {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  background: var(--ms-blue-faint);
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  display: flex;
}

.kra-add-row input {
  flex: 1;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.kpi-card {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  margin-top: 10px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
}

.kpi-header {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  display: flex;
}

.kpi-title {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.kpi-meta {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  margin-top: 2px;
  font-family: Cascadia Code, Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.kpi-badge {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  border-radius: 4px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  font-size: 11px;

}

.kpi-badge-on-target {
  background: var(--ms-green-light);
  color: var(--ms-green);
}

.kpi-badge-on-track {
  background: var(--ms-orange-light);
  color: var(--ms-orange);
}

.kpi-badge-at-risk {
  background: var(--ms-red-light);
  color: var(--ms-red);
}

.bar-track {

}

.bar-fill {

}

.bar-green {
  background: var(--ms-green);
}

.bar-orange {
  background: var(--ms-orange);
}

.bar-red {
  background: var(--ms-red);
}

.inline-row {

.section-divider {

  gap: 20px;

}

.score-big {

.score-text h4 {

.score-text p {
  margin: 0;

}

.dept-selector label {

.dept-selector select {
